description: Returns dental associate compensation benchmarks for a US state, computed from recent job listings: average and median base salary, daily rate, production percentage, signing bonuses, and how often listings include health insurance, 401(k), or paid malpractice. Figures are omitted when the sample is too small. Relevant when a dentist asks what associates are paid in a state or how pay is usually structured there.

state.description: US state as a 2-letter postal code (e.g. TX, CA, DC). Full state names are also accepted.

name: dental_salary_benchmarks
title: Dental associate salary benchmarks by state
